cohort: 127 singleton pregnancies with placenta previa and low-lying placenta diagnosed at 30-33 weeks of gestation
finding: Repeated ultrasound evaluations of placental position after late preterm were valuable in determining the best mode of delivery for women with placenta previa and low-lying placenta.
mod_finding: Repeated evaluations of placental position by ultrasonography after late preterm could be of significant value in selecting the most appropriate mode of delivery for patients with placenta previa and low-lying placenta.
